title: Guarding with Judgment: Learning to Intervene for Multimodal Safety
abstract: arXiv:2611.28849v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When visual context makes an ordinary request unsafe to answer as asked, a blanket refusal may leave the user's need unresolved. Choosing how to help requires distinguishing an established hazard from a condition that still needs verification, a distinction that binary safety labels leave unspecified. We formulate this decision through four actions: allow, warn, review, and refuse. To ground these decisions in verifiable evidence, we build a corpus of 20,126 training audits and the JudiBench benchmark, connecting each action to diagnostic judgments, source evidence, and controlled context changes. Our guard, JudiAct, separately states what the source establishes, what condition governs the help, and how the rules apply. It then checks these three brief review items against the original inputs to predict diagnostic labels and a handling action. translated_title: 以判断守护：学习干预以实现多模态安全
translated_abstract: 当视觉上下文使得一个原本普通的请求按原样回答变得不安全时，一刀切的拒绝可能无法解决用户的真实需求。选择如何提供帮助，需要区分已经确立的风险与仍需进一步验证的情况，而二元安全标签并未明确这一区分。我们通过四种操作来构建这一决策：允许、警告、审查和拒绝。为了使这些决策建立在可验证的证据之上，我们构建了包含 20,126 条训练审计记录的语料库以及 JudiBench 基准，将每种操作与诊断性判断、来源证据和受控的上下文变化相连接。我们的守护模型 JudiAct 分别陈述来源所确立的内容、支配帮助方式的条件以及规则如何适用，然后将这三项简短的审查内容与原始输入进行核对，以预测诊断标签和处理操作。监督训练在学习各项独立判断的同时，比较相关……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出多模态安全守护模型 JudiAct，以“允许、警告、审查、拒绝”四种细粒度干预动作取代二元拒绝决策，并基于包含 20,126 条审计记录的语料库和 JudiBench 基准，通过可验证的诊断判断与证据来学习干预策略。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes JudiAct, a multimodal safety guard that learns fine-grained interventions (allow, warn, review, refuse) beyond binary refusal, grounded in verifiable diagnostic judgments, source evidence, a 20,126-audit training corpus, and the JudiBench benchmark.
